# Binance.US Support

> > Official help center for Binance.US, providing guides on crypto deposits, withdrawals, customer support access, and account management for the U.S.-based cryptocurrency exchange.

Binance.US is the United States-based cryptocurrency exchange platform, operating separately from Binance.com. This support site offers comprehensive documentation on funding methods including ACH and wire transfers, crypto transactions, and access to customer support via AI Chatbot and Help Center.

## Key Topics

- Binance.US platform
- Crypto deposits and withdrawals
- ACH transfers
- Wire transfers
- USD fiat funding
- Customer support and AI Chatbot
- Help Center resources
- Deposit addresses and wallet funding
- Mobile app and web browser guides
- Cryptocurrency transfer instructions
- Account funding methods
- Live chat support
- AVAX and Avalanche
- Contact methods

## Customer Support

- [How to contact Binance.US customer support](https://support.binance.us/en/articles/9842955-how-to-contact-binance-us-customer-support): Guide to contacting Binance.US Support via AI Chatbot and Help Center

## Deposits & Withdrawals

- [Deposits & Withdrawals](https://support.binance.us/en/collections/10384430-deposits-withdrawals): Collection covering ACH, wire, crypto deposits/withdrawals, and fiat funding
- [How to deposit crypto into your Binance.US account](https://support.binance.us/en/articles/9842851-how-to-deposit-crypto-into-your-binance-us-account): Step-by-step instructions for depositing crypto into Binance.US account
